decision: Author five repository-specific skills. No public skill code or text is vendored; no collection installed.

sources.useful: Progressive disclosure and realistic measurable skill checks.
sources.not_adopted: Claude-specific evaluation commands, mandatory multi-run subagent workflow and viewer infrastructure add unnecessary inference/dependencies for these short Rust repository skills. Use existing offline Rust/HTTP/MCP/Node checks instead.

sources.useful: Completion claims require fresh observable evidence.
sources.not_adopted: Do not import an entire workflow collection or rigid universal process. Repository-native acceptance and denial tests provide scoped evidence.

attribution_policy: Keep these revision/license pointers. If a later change copies or adapts source text/code, retain the applicable full license, notices and modification attribution with that material. These independently authored skills use the repository MIT license.
